text: The workflow brief 2.1.48→2.1.49 addresses the user-jobs table for the system verifier as `pages/SKILL.md` section 13 (`oq23nb0j`). At 2.1.49 that section holds only `<single_element type="spreadsheet" slug="moduly-feature"/>` — the module index table (columns #, Moduł, Złożoność, Warstwy, Zakres, Plik), which names no user jobs (who does what, success sentence, modules walked across). Assumed: the specification has no user-jobs table at 2.1.49; no unit owns a job and the system verifier works from the units' criteria. Either the brief generator should not emit a jobs convention pointing at the module table, or the specification should gain a real user-jobs table.
